content.text: {"id": "mm6747a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "4,836 (73.7%) visited the ART center, compared with 1,688 (45.9%)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "9,898 (39.6%) persons initiated ART during May 2017–June 2018"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among these 6,524 persons, 6,315 (96.8%) initiated ART."}]}, {"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "a median of 1,847 (IQR = 1,615–2,007) persons with HIV infection initiated ART each month"}]}, {"v": "continuous", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the median CD4 count was 571 cells/mm 3 (IQR = 412–759)"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "9,898 (40%) subsequently initiated ART over a 14-month period"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "4,836 (73.7%) visited the ART center, compared with 1,688 (45.9%)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "After May 1, 2017, this number increased, peaking at 3,797 in July"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the assumption that 50% of enrolled persons not on ART would initiate ART within 6 months"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Before implementation of Treat All, a median of 1,847 (IQR = 1,615–2,007) persons with HIV infection initiated ART each month"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Paper records were reviewed to deduplicate entries with matching names and addresses and to verify ART status and contact information."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "retention on ART, defined as documented receipt of ART at specific time points (e.g., 6 or 12 months)"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "subsequently did not visit the ART center for ≥12 months"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "ART center–based records were used to monitor implementation indicators, including ART initiation."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design", "outcome_types"]}
